features.text: TasteLock™ Plus Crispers with Auto-Humidity Control

Keep produce tasting fresh like nature intended with smart crisper technology that removes excess moisture and blocks out dry air to prevent shriveling and shrinking, plus an ethylene absorber reduces the gas emitted by many fruits and vegetables that causes spoiling.
Flexible Organization System
Find a place for everything with our thoughtful organization solutions that maximize usable space, including in-door condiment storage, a slide-under shelf, snack storage and optional storage pan.
Adjustable Temperature Drawer
Entertain with ease with our adjustable temperature drawer with three temperature settings so you can keep everything from charcuterie boards to white wine at the perfect serving temperature.
LuxCool™ Cooling System
Keep food market fresh by maintaining a constant temperature with smart sensing technology and a variable-speed compressor which efficiently circulates cold air throughout the refrigerator.
Internal Water Dispenser
Filtered water right from you refrigerator, while allowing for a clean exterior look.
Auto-Close Doors
Avoid spoiled food and wasted energy with auto-close doors, which ensure that your refrigerator is not left slightly open by mistake.
Pure Advantage™ Refrigerator Air Filter
More powerful than baking soda, PureAdvantage™ refrigerator air filters keep your refrigerator at its freshest by capturing and keeping undesirable odors at bay.
Quick Freeze
Quickly freeze foods so they stay at their freshest - set this option before a large grocery run so your food freezes faster once you get home.
Platinum Star® Limited Warranty
Our exclusive warranty offers peace of mind for registered owners with two years of coverage on replacement parts.
ENERGY STAR® Certified
Save money and maximize energy efficiency with ENERGY STAR® Certified Appliances.
Pure Advantage™ Water and Ice Filter
Clean life-giving water from your fridge every day – PureAdvantage™ water filters deliver refreshing, great tasting water and ice with up to 99% contaminant
Get a Built-In Look with Counter-Depth Design
Our counter-depth refrigerator sits flush with existing cabinetry, making it easy to achieve a sleek, built-in look.
Premium LED Lighting
Our designer LED lighting is as beautiful as it is functional, keeping the contents of your refrigerator clearly visible.
